'''Healing amulets''' were [[Sith sorcery/Legends|magical]] [[Sith talisman/Legends|devices]] that allowed [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warriors to heal themselves through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while in the heat of battle. Created by pureblooded members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], these amulets stimulated the physical body's natural healing processes, at the expense of the individual's ability to manipulate the Force. The [[Sith sorcerer]] [[Rin Shuuir]] possessed such an amulet which he used to heal the Sith warrior [[Utris]].
